🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Badezimmer (Bathroom)

der Föhn = hairdryer
das Badezimmer = bathroom
die Dusche = shower
die Seife = soap
das Handtuch = towel
die Zahnbürste = toothbrush

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
